pairs_touching.what_says_this: Grouped by CO-OCCURRENCE (2x) within the same Constitutional Invariant Map census/deferred-mechanisms tables. Unlike most sibling pairs in this cluster, this one has a direct pairwise ruling: S0237's 'Compression-test rulings (UM-22 protocol)' cluster (8) explicitly tests 'Dialogue-001<->Contradiction-001<->Revisability-001<->Intent-001' together and rules them COMPLEMENTARY -- i.e. the governance protocol specifically examined whether Dialogue-001 (structured opposition, a PROCESS invariant, Family 7 CONTRADICTION) and Intent-001 (purpose/intent of reasoning, Family 6 REASONING, 'genuinely novel row') were redundant/mergeable and ruled they are not, keeping both as distinct, complementary, non-compressed candidates. Both were separately validated (S0239): Dialogue-001 -> ENGINE/DEFERRED; Intent-001 -> ENGINE/DEFERRED (different reasons: Dialogue's content already in laws 8+11; Intent's corruption already covered by laws 6+7).
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a later register version reversed the COMPLEMENTARY ruling and merged the two into one row, that would establish a real SAME/REDEFINITION relationship.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: Only evidence is group_evidence G1211, a CO-OCCURRENCE row (labels co-occur 3 times). No lineage claims, no POSSIBLY-RELATION note. Both objects are small and not truncated.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: Wrong if a corpus row is found explicitly deriving the intent-of-reasoning hypothesis from, or unifying it with, the failed-reasoning-preservation hypothesis beyond co-listing in the same H-KOS hypothesis register.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Both fully sampled (5/5, 4/4, no truncation). Same registry-census source (S0237/S0239) as RP0791 -- both pairs in this batch drawn from the same 25-row Kernel-candidate consolidation exercise, reinforcing that this census structure produces many superficially-co-occurring but substantively unrelated label pairs.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Same S0237/S0239 candidate-register census pattern as RP0791. Both A (H-KOS-Fallacy-001) and B (H-KOS-Intent-001) are two of the 25 candidates in the shared Family 6 REASONING table (9 rows), but the ten named compression-test clusters test each against DIFFERENT other candidates, never against each other: cluster 7 is 'Fallacy-001<->Failure-001 -> COMPLEMENTARY' (A paired with Failure-001, not B); cluster 8 is 'Dialogue-001<->Contradiction-001<->Revisability-001<->Intent-001 -> COMPLEMENTARY' (B paired with Dialogue/Contradiction/Revisability, not A). Their final validation outcomes also diverge: H-KOS-Fallacy-001 is STRONG, promoted to KERNEL (state content -> law 7) + ENGINE (detection machinery); H-KOS-Intent-001 is MODERATE, ruled ENGINE-only and DEFERRED ('its corruption already covered by law 6 + law 7 -- useful; not constitutional').
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a fuller reading of the reasoning-family register showed Fallacy-001 and Intent-001 sharing a dependency (e.g. intent-detection feeding fallacy classification), this could support a real relationship. No such link appears in the sampled compression clusters or validation rows -- they are adjacent entries in the same family table with independent dispositions.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Same catalogue-co-occurrence pattern as RP0807/RP0877/RP0894; the underlying register document (S0237/S0239) drives most of this batch's weak CO-OCCURRENCE pairs.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: Both labels co-occur only because they are two of the nine rows in the same 'Family 6 -- REASONING' table within the same register census document (S0237/S0239); no lineage_claims connect them in either direction. The census's own ten named compression-test clusters pair a (H-KOS-Intent-001) specifically with cluster (8) Dialogue-001<->Contradiction-001<->Revisability-001<->Intent-001 -> COMPLEMENTARY -- not with b. b (H-KOS-Reasoning-Provenance-001) is not named in any compression-test cluster at all, and receives its own independent validation verdict (MODERATE-STRONG -> KERNEL, SURVIVES law 6, 'the path is part of justification') separate from a's (MODERATE -> ENGINE, DEFERRED, 'its corruption already covered by law 6 + law 7').
